name: KinCast
summary: Your family's private YouTube: share home videos and go live, with family chat.
description:
KinCast is a private video site for the whole family. Upload home videos from any device and they're converted to play smoothly everywhere. Go live from OBS or a phone for recitals, birthdays and games, with family chat. Subscribe to each other's channels and get notified about new videos. Everything stays on this server and needs a family sign-in.

After installing, open KinCast to create the family and your admin account, then invite everyone from the Family page.

settings.label: Video qualities
settings.help: Each upload is converted to these qualities. Fewer qualities process faster and use less space.

settings.label: Processing speed
settings.help: Faster presets finish sooner but make bigger files.
